meta.title: Revised Lba Rda And Council Formal Meeting

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer to the public hearing on June 7, 2022 (LBA Budget for the Capital Projects Fund for Fiscal Year 2022-23)
votes.description: Closes the first public hearing on the LBA Capital Projects Fund budget for FY2022-23, which covers bond debt service for the Glendale and Marmalade Libraries, and refers it to the June 7 hearing.
Procedural motion to adjourn the Local Building Authority board meeting.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer to the public hearing on June 7, 2022 (RDA Budget for Fiscal Year 2022-23)
votes.description: Closes the first public hearing on the Redevelopment Agency budget for FY2022-23 and refers it to the June 7 hearing.
Procedural motion to adjourn the Redevelopment Agency board meeting.

votes.motion: Adopt Joint Ceremonial Resolution 14 of 2022, celebrating Pride Month
votes.description: Adopts a joint ceremonial resolution with Mayor Mendenhall recognizing June 2022 as Pride Month in Salt Lake City.

votes.motion: Approve the formal meeting minutes of February 1, 2022 and April 19, 2022 as well as the limited formal meeting minutes of May 10, 2022
votes.description: Approves three sets of prior City Council meeting minutes as the official record.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and refer items G-1 through G-4 to a future Consent Agenda for action (grant applications: RMHIDTA, YouthCity School Age Quality, YouthCity School Age Summer Quality Expansion, and Summer Food Service Program)
votes.description: Closes the combined public hearing on four grant applications from the Police Department and Division of Youth and Family Services and refers them to a future consent agenda for approval.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing and adopt Ordinance 25 of 2022: Library Budget Amendment No. 1 for Fiscal Year 2021-22 (item A-1 only: increase library budget for pass-through property tax increment related to the Inland Port and Convention Center Hotel, $500,000 from pass-through Property Taxes)
votes.description: Closes the public hearing and adopts a library budget amendment increasing the library budget to account for pass-through property tax increments legally required to be forwarded to the Utah Inland Port and County Convention Center Hotel.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing on the Series 2022 bond issuance (Public Utilities Revenue Bonds, Series 2022)
votes.description: Closes the public hearing on the parameters resolution authorizing up to $360,000,000 in Public Utilities revenue bonds for water, sewer, and storm water capital improvements.

votes.motion: Close the public hearing for items G7 through G16 and refer to public hearing on June 7, 2022 (FY2022-23 budget-related ordinances)
votes.description: Closes the first public hearing on ten FY2022-23 budget implementation ordinances covering topics such as business licensing, recreation fees, tax levy, library budget, fee schedule, MOU appropriations, compensation plan, and city budget, and refers them to the June 7 hearing.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 26 of 2022: Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at 1950 S West Temple and 1948 S West Temple, subject to conditions (parcel consolidation and restrictive covenant limiting building height to 35 feet)
votes.description: Rezones properties at 1950 and a portion of 1948 South West Temple from RMF-35 to CG and amends the Central Community Master Plan Future Land Use Map, to facilitate expansion of Intermountain Wood Products, with conditions requiring parcel consolidation and a recorded height restriction covenant.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 27 of 2022: Rezone and Master Plan Amendment at 1902 South 400 East
votes.description: Amends the Central Community Master Plan Future Land Use Map from Low Density to Medium Density Residential and rezones the property from R-1-5,000 to RMF-35 to facilitate construction of townhomes (maximum five units with square footage restrictions).

votes.motion: Reconsider action on May 10 relative to the resolution authorizing approval of the redistricting map
votes.description: Procedural motion to reconsider the May 10, 2022 vote on the redistricting resolution in order to correct a boundary error affecting Districts Three and Six.

votes.motion: Approve Resolution 9 of 2022 Redistricting City Council District Boundaries, designating boundaries based on the 2020 Census results as shown on Exhibit A, correcting the boundaries of Districts Three and Six to move a single property from District Six into District Three
votes.description: Adopts the corrected City Council district boundary map based on 2020 Census results, fixing an error that had inadvertently placed one property in District Six instead of District Three.

votes.motion: Adopt Ordinance 28 of 2022: Protecting Patient Privacy and Rights Near Healthcare Facilities
votes.description: Adopts an ordinance establishing clearer guidelines for the time, place, and manner of free speech near medical facility patient access points to protect patient privacy and security.

votes.motion: Approve the Consent Agenda (board appointments: Sarah Sherer to Sugar House Park Authority; Aaron Wiley to PNUT Board; Cale Newhouse to Arts Council; reappointment of Amy Barry to Planning Commission)
votes.description: Approves four board appointments and reappointments to various City advisory bodies as a single consent agenda action.
